query: UPDATE jobs SET status = $3, result = CAST($1 AS jsonb), completed_at = clock_timestamp(), active_attempt_id = $4 WHERE id = $2 AND status = $5 AND EXISTS ( SELECT $6 FROM job_attempts a WHERE a.id = jobs.active_attempt_id AND a.status = $7 AND a.lease_until > clock_timestamp() AND a.deadline_at > clock_timestamp())
UPDATE jobs SET status=$4,active_attempt_id=$1,attempt_count=attempt_count+$5, deadline_at=$2,retry_at=$6 WHERE id=$3

WITH inserted AS ( INSERT INTO job_events (job_id,event_type,status,related_job_id,attempt_id) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5) RETURNING job_id,attempt_id) SELECT j.type,a.queue_delay_seconds,a.status AS attempt_status, CASE WHEN a.finished_at IS NULL THEN $6 ELSE greatest($7,extract($8 FROM (a.finished_at-a.started_at))) END::double precision AS execution_seconds FROM inserted e JOIN jobs j ON j.id=e.job_id LEFT JOIN job_attempts a ON a.id=e.attempt_id

WITH timing AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS at), deadline AS (SELECT at, COALESCE(CAST($1 AS timestamptz), at + make_interval(secs => $2)) AS until FROM timing) INSERT INTO job_attempts(id,job_id,attempt_number,generation,claim_token,worker_id,status, started_at,heartbeat_at,lease_until,deadline_at,queue_delay_seconds) SELECT $3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$11,at,at, LEAST(at + make_interval(secs => $9),until),until, CASE WHEN j.eligible_at IS NULL THEN $12 ELSE greatest($13,extract($14 FROM (at-j.eligible_at))) END FROM deadline CROSS JOIN jobs j WHERE j.id=$10 RETURNING *
UPDATE job_attempts SET status=$1,error=$2,finished_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=$3 AND status=$4
SELECT json_build_object($1,count(*),$2,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ($3,$4,$5))) FROM jobs WHERE owner_id=$6

SELECT j.id FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN job_attempts a ON a.id=j.active_attempt_id WHERE (j.status='?' AND (a.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() OR a.deadline_at<=clock_timestamp())) OR (j.status='?' AND j.deadline_at<=clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY j.deadline_at,j.id LIMIT 20 FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT j.* FROM jobs j JOIN job_attempts a ON a.id=j.active_attempt_id WHERE j.id=$1 AND j.status=$5 AND j.generation=$2 AND a.id=$3 AND a.claim_token=$4 AND a.status=$6 FOR UPDATE OF j
INSERT INTO job_metric_counts(event,job_type,stripe,value) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4) ON CONFLICT(event,job_type,stripe) DO UPDATE SET value=job_metric_counts.value+EXCLUDED.value

INSERT INTO job_metric_timings(kind,job_type,outcome,stripe,sample_count,total_seconds) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) ON CONFLICT(kind,job_type,outcome,stripe) DO UPDATE SET sample_count=job_metric_timings.sample_count+EXCLUDED.sample_count, total_seconds=job_metric_timings.total_seconds+EXCLUDED.total_seconds
SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id = $1
SELECT type,status,count(*) AS count FROM jobs GROUP BY type,status

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE retry_at>clock_timestamp()) AS waiting, count(*) FILTER (WHERE retry_at<=clock_timestamp()) AS due, coalesce(max(greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM (clock_timestamp()- coalesce(eligible_at,greatest(created_at,scheduled_at,retry_at)))))),0) AS oldest FROM jobs WHERE status='?'
SELECT job_id, priority, generation FROM job_outbox WHERE available_at <= now() ORDER BY priority DESC, available_at, created_at, job_id LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

WITH timing AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS at) SELECT lease_until > at AS lease_live, deadline_at > at AS deadline_live, greatest($2,extract($3 FROM (lease_until-at))*$4)::bigint AS lease_ms, greatest($5,extract($6 FROM (deadline_at-at))*$7)::bigint AS deadline_ms FROM job_attempts,timing WHERE id=$1
SELECT GREATEST(coalesce(scheduled_at,created_at),retry_at)<=clock_timestamp() FROM jobs WHERE id=$1
SELECT deadline_at<=clock_timestamp() FROM jobs WHERE id=$1
SELECT event,job_type,sum(value) AS value FROM job_metric_counts GROUP BY event,job_type
SELECT count(*) FROM jobs j JOIN job_attempts a ON a.id=j.active_attempt_id WHERE j.status='?' AND a.lease_until<=clock_timestamp()
SELECT kind,job_type,outcome,sum(sample_count) AS sample_count,sum(total_seconds) AS total_seconds FROM job_metric_timings GROUP BY kind,job_type,outcome

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE available_at<=clock_timestamp()) AS due, count(*) FILTER (WHERE available_at>clock_timestamp()) AS scheduled, coalesce(max(greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM (clock_timestamp()-available_at)))) FILTER (WHERE available_at<=clock_timestamp()),0) AS oldest FROM job_outbox
SELECT state,count(*) AS count FROM dead_letters GROUP BY state
